$comment: Written by agentic-cms schema from the collection's zod schema; do not edit by hand.

from.description: The old path, as it was indexed: /words, without a trailing slash; never a live page's or post's path

to.description: Where it goes now: a page's path, a post's URL or the blog index, or an https:// URL; never another redirect's from

permanent.description: true, or left out: a permanent redirect (308), which search engines follow and index the target of; false: a temporary one (307)

items.description: A redirect from a URL the site no longer answers, in content/redirects.yaml; next.config.ts serves them (redirectsFor())

description: content/redirects.yaml: A redirect from a URL the site no longer answers, in content/redirects.yaml; next.config.ts serves them (redirectsFor()) (one file holding a list, one entry per item).
